task: Predict ARID1A mutation status in lung squamous cell carcinoma. Classes: wildtype vs. mutant. On H&E, potentially informative differences may include variation in keratinization, tumor architecture, cytologic atypia, necrosis, and the degree of inflammatory or stromal reaction, although mutation-associated morphology can be subtle.

classes.0: ARID1A wildtype lung squamous cell carcinoma without distinctive mutation-associated morphologic pattern.
classes.1: ARID1A mutant lung squamous cell carcinoma with altered differentiation, architectural disorder, or atypical inflammatory-stromal context on H&E.
